offering_description.value: Microvast designs and manufactures lithium-ion batteries for commercial and specialty vehicle manufacturers. It makes cells and assembles them into modules and packs, and supplies stationary battery systems for grid energy storage.

primary_products.value: lithium-ion cells; battery modules; vehicle battery packs; stationary battery energy storage systems

customer_segment.value: B2B: Commercial and specialty vehicle manufacturers, energy storage developers and system integrators

end_markets.value: commercial electric vehicles; off-highway and industrial equipment; grid-scale energy storage

revenue_model.value: product sales: Battery cells, modules, vehicle packs and stationary energy storage systems

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Processes battery materials into cells and systems for vehicle manufacturers and energy storage developers; component supplier: Supplies cells, modules and packs for integration into vehicles and equipment

geography_served.value: global: China, Europe and North America

specialization.value: related lines: Lithium-ion cells, commercial vehicle battery packs and stationary storage systems

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Supply agreements with vehicle manufacturers and energy storage customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Battery transport testing under UN 38.3 and environmental and workplace safety rules for manufacturing

notes: The current scale of the stationary energy storage business is uncertain.
